privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How BLE$$ P collects, uses, shares and protects your personal information, and the rights you hold under Quebec's Law 25, PIPEDA and the GDPR.
privacy.questionsAboutPrivacy: Have questions about how we handle your personal information?

identity.title: 1. Who We Are
identity.content:
This Privacy Policy explains how BLE$$ P, a luxury streetwear retailer headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, collects, uses, discloses and protects your personal information when you browse our website, create an account or place an order. It applies alongside our Terms & Conditions.

BLE$$ P is responsible for the personal information in its custody. As required by Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25), we have designated a person in charge of the protection of personal information, whom you can reach at the address below.

dataCollected.title: 2. Personal Information We Collect
dataCollected.content:
We collect only the information we need to run the shop and serve you. Depending on how you use the site, this includes:

• Account information: your first and last name, email address and a securely hashed password (we never store passwords in plain text).
• Order information: the items you purchase, your shipping and billing addresses and, when provided, your phone number for delivery.
• Guest checkout: the email address used to send your order confirmation and receipt.
• Payment information: payments are processed by Stripe. Your full card number never reaches our servers; we keep only non-sensitive references such as the card brand, last four digits and expiry date.
• Marketing information: your email address when you subscribe to the newsletter, and your email notification preferences.
• Content you share: product reviews, wishlist items and messages sent through the contact form.
• Loyalty information: the points you earn and redeem on your purchases.
• Sign-in information: if you sign in with Google or Apple, we receive your name and email address from that provider; if you enable two-factor authentication, we store the secret required to verify your codes.
• Technical information: the cookies and browser storage described in section 9.

purposes.title: 3. How We Use Your Information

legalBases.title: 4. Legal Bases
legalBases.content:
Under Quebec's Law 25 and the federal Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA), we collect and use your personal information with your consent, which you may withdraw at any time, subject to legal or contractual restrictions.

For customers located in the European Economic Area, the GDPR requires a legal basis for each use: performance of a contract (account, orders, deliveries), consent (newsletter, promotional emails), legal obligation (tax and accounting records) and legitimate interest (fraud prevention and platform security).

processors.title: 5. Service Providers and Sharing
processors.content:
We share personal information only with the providers needed to operate the shop, and only to the extent necessary:

• Stripe, our payment processor, receives the information required to charge your payment method and prevent fraud.
• Resend or Postmark deliver our transactional and marketing emails.
• Google and Apple act as sign-in providers when you choose social login.
• Shipping carriers receive your name, delivery address and, when provided, phone number in order to deliver your order.
• Our hosting and infrastructure providers store the information described in this policy on our behalf.

Each provider is bound by contractual confidentiality and security obligations and may not use your information for its own purposes. We may also disclose information where the law requires it, for example to comply with a court order.

transfers.title: 6. International Transfers
transfers.content:
Your personal information may be stored or processed outside your province or country. In particular, our hosting infrastructure and Stripe operate servers in the United States.

Before transferring personal information outside Quebec or Canada, we assess the protection it will receive and put contractual safeguards in place, as required by Law 25 and PIPEDA. For customers in the European Economic Area, transfers rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an applicable adequacy decision.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.content:
We keep personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes described above:

• Account information is kept until you delete your account, which you can do at any time from your profile.
• Order and invoicing records are kept for 7 years after the transaction, as required by Canadian tax and accounting rules, even if the associated account is deleted.
• Newsletter subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe.
• Contact form messages are kept for the time needed to resolve your request.

Once a retention period expires, we delete the information or anonymize it irreversibly.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and Browser Storage

children.title: 10. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our website is intended for a general audience and is not directed at children. In line with Quebec's Law 25, we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 14 years of age without the consent of a parent or guardian. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact us at privacy@blessp.com and we will delete it.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this policy from time to time, for example when we introduce a new feature or when the law evolves. The effective date at the top of this page always reflects the current version, and we will announce any material change on the site before it takes effect. This policy took effect on July 13, 2026.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content:
At BLE$$ P, we are committed to ensuring your complete satisfaction with every purchase. We understand that sometimes an item may not meet your expectations, and we want the return process to be as seamless as possible.

This Return Policy outlines the terms and conditions for returning or exchanging products purchased through our website. Please read this policy carefully before initiating a return.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.content:
Items are eligible for return within 30 days of the delivery date. To qualify for a return, the following conditions must be met:

• The item must be unworn, unwashed, and free of any alterations.
• All original tags and labels must be attached.
• The item must be returned in its original packaging.
• Proof of purchase (order confirmation email or receipt) is required.

Items returned outside the 30-day window or that do not meet the above conditions may be refused or returned to you at your expense.

condition.title: Condition Requirements
condition.content:
We inspect all returned items upon receipt. Items must be in resalable condition to qualify for a refund or exchange. This means:

• No signs of wear, including odors, stains, pet hair, or makeup marks.
• No missing buttons, zippers, or other components.
• Items must not have been tailored or altered in any way.
• Shoes must be returned in their original shoe box, which must be in its original condition.

We reserve the right to decline a return if the item does not meet these requirements.

process.title: How to Initiate a Return
process.content:
To start a return, please follow these steps:

1. Contact our support team at returns@blessp.com or through the Contact page on our website. Include your order number and the item(s) you wish to return.

2. You will receive a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number along with detailed instructions and a prepaid return shipping label (for domestic orders).

3. Pack the item(s) securely in their original packaging, attach the return label, and drop the package off at the designated carrier location.

4. Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you by email regarding the status of your refund or exchange.

Please do not send items back without first obtaining an RMA number, as unauthorized returns may not be processed.

refunds.title: Refund Process
refunds.content:
Approved refunds will be issued to your original payment method. Please allow 5 to 10 business days for the refund to appear on your statement after we have processed the return.

• Credit/debit card refunds may take an additional 2 to 5 business days depending on your financial institution.
• Original shipping costs are non-refundable unless the return is due to a defect or an error on our part.
• If you paid using a promotional code or gift card, the refund will be issued as store credit.

You will receive an email confirmation once your refund has been processed.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.content:
We offer exchanges for a different size or color of the same item, subject to availability. To request an exchange, please follow the same process as a return and indicate your preferred replacement item.

If the requested item is not available, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.

Exchanges are processed within 3 to 5 business days of receiving the returned item. A new order confirmation will be sent to your email with updated tracking information.

nonReturnable.title: Non-Returnable Items
nonReturnable.content:
The following items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged:

• Items marked as "Final Sale" or purchased during clearance promotions.
• Gift cards.
• Intimate apparel and swimwear (for hygiene reasons).
• Items that have been personalized or customized.
• Items purchased through third-party retailers (please refer to the retailer's return policy).

Please review product descriptions carefully before purchasing, as non-returnable items will be clearly indicated on the product page.

damaged.title: Damaged or Defective Items
damaged.content:
If you receive an item that is damaged, defective, or incorrect, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery. Include your order number, a description of the issue, and photographs of the item and packaging.

We will arrange for a prepaid return label at no cost to you and, depending on your preference, provide a replacement item or a full refund, including any original shipping charges.

Quality is at the core of everything we do, and we take reports of defective items very seriously. Your feedback helps us maintain the standards our customers expect.
